name: Morph Loader
description: A tiny loader whose two strokes morph circle to square to triangle while it works, then fold into a check or a cross in place when the job lands.

props.name: status
props.description: idle rests on the first shape at 45% opacity; loading morphs through shapes; success folds into a check; error into a cross. Changes start from wherever the strokes are, so a status change mid-morph never jumps.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered size in px. The drawing scales and the stroke stays strokeWidth px.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke weight in px at the rendered size.

props.name: speed
props.description: Loop speed multiplier. At 1 it morphs one shape every 0.9 s and turns once every 2.6 s.

props.name: shapes
props.description: The shapes the loop morphs through, in order. The first one is also the idle pose.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink while idle or loading. Inherits the text colour by default.

props.name: announce
props.description: Renders a polite live region with the current label. Turn it off when a parent (a button, a row) already announces the state.

props.name: onSettled
props.description: Called once the fold into a check or a cross has landed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root span.
